g.text: C206 · Figure 1.3: an SOI photonic chip and the single-package promise (§1.2.1)

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Many optical functions on one silicon chip, built in microelectronics fabs — so moving data through fibre gets far cheaper.

g.text: “The great promise of silicon photonics lies in integrating multiple

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: functions into a single package, and manufacturing most or all of them

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: using the same fabrication facilities that are used to build advanced

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: microelectronics, as part of a single chip or chip stack … Doing so will

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ff9f0a

g.text: radically drive down the cost of moving data through fibres.”

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff

g.text: Book, §1.2.1 (with Fig 1.3: SOI chip fabricated at IME A*STAR, p.7).

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Caveat: the laser is the exception — bonded on, not yet monolithic (p.6).

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Takeaway: one silicon chip already holds waveguide arrays, grating couplers, routing and functional blocks.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Building most or all functions in one package, in the fabs that make microelectronics, replaces many costly

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ff9f0a

g.text: separately packaged parts — and radically cuts the cost of moving data through fibres.
